meta.name: ai-music-generation
meta.description: Generate AI music and songs with ElevenLabs, Diffrythm, Tencent Song Generation via inference.sh CLI. Models: ElevenLabs Music (up to 10 min, commercial license), Diffrythm (fast song generation), Tencent Song Generation (full songs with vocals). Capabilities: text-to-music, song generation, instrumental, lyrics to song, soundtrack creation. Use for: background music, social media content, game soundtracks, podcasts, royalty-free music. Triggers: music generation, ai music, generate song, ai composer, text to music, song generator, create music with ai, suno alternative, udio alternative, ai song, ai soundtrack, generate soundtrack, ai jingle, music ai, beat generator, elevenlabs music, eleven labs music

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成音乐和歌曲
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成免版税音乐用于内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Generate music and songs from text descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need royalty-free music for your content quickly

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行生成 AI 音乐和歌曲，支持文本生成音乐、歌词生成歌曲、配乐等。
howto.when: 当你提到“生成音乐”“AI 歌曲”等关键词，或要求制作背景音乐、游戏配乐时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一首 upbeat 电子舞曲。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Diffrythm 模型生成音乐。

say.text: 用 ElevenLabs 生成一段 5 分钟的钢琴曲。
为我的播客制作一个 10 秒的科技风开场曲。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate AI music and songs via command line, supporting text-to-music, lyrics-to-song, soundtrack creation, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'generate music', 'AI song', or request background music, game soundtrack, etc.

say_en.text: Generate an upbeat electronic dance track.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Diffrythm model.

say_en.text: Create a 5-minute piano piece with ElevenLabs.
Make a 10-second tech-themed intro for my podcast.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a short jingle.
